newsitem.title: USA: First Washington Realty sets share offer.
newsitem.headline: First Washington Realty sets share offer.

text.p: First Washington Realty Trust Inc said Monday that it filed to offer shares of its common stock, adding that the deal is valued at about $37 million.

In a release Monday the company said all shares offered are to be issued and sold by First Washington with net proceeds going to fund the acquisition of six additional shopping centers, expansion of existing centers and the reduction of certain mortgage financing.
Underwriters of the offering are Alex Brown & Sons Inc, Friedman, Billings, Ramsey & Co Inc and Tucker Anthony Inc, the company said.
